findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. The SVG has `width="260"`, while `.board-picture` sets only `max-width: 100%`. The supplied 1440-pixel client screenshots show the dependency map confined to a narrow strip inside its full-width slot. This leaves the roadmap cramped instead of using the available laptop width.
findings.title: Roadmap map is fixed at 260 pixels on laptop

stop.reason: Coordinator (Harm 2, reversible): the map keeps its natural size in this part, as the PAGE row says (moved unchanged); stretching it makes labels about 5 times larger. Filling the full-width slot belongs to the GRAPH part, which redraws the map.
